{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''The Despotica''''' was a vast literary collection on [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. It contained "[[The Gleam of Kiirium]]," purported to be [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Asenec]] of [[Crakull]].
